name: Librarysol Book Catalogue Manager – The Ultimate Free WordPress Book Catalogue Plugin
author: librarysol

sections.description:
Librarysol Book Catalogue Manager is a powerful, free, all-in-one WordPress book catalogue and book gallery plugin designed for authors, publishers, public and school libraries, book bloggers, collectors, and book-related businesses. Whether you’re creating a beautiful book showcase, organizing a personal library, or publishing a searchable online book catalogue, Librarysol gives your books a professional home on WordPress.

Add unlimited books, authors, categories, genres, and series, display responsive galleries, and help visitors discover titles with search, filtering, sorting, and dedicated book pages — without a licence, usage quota, or required paid add-on.

🚀 Key Features

✔ Unlimited Books & Authors
Build a collection of any size. Add as many books, authors, categories, genres, and series as you need, with no artificial catalogue limits.

✔ Beautiful Book Galleries
Showcase your titles in responsive grid and list layouts, complete with book covers and individual book pages.

✔ Search, Filters & Sorting
Make large collections easier to explore with book search, basic filters, sorting, and pagination.

✔ Detailed Book Information
Create informative book profiles with title, cover, author, ISBN, publisher, publication year, page count, language, description, edition, and format.

✔ Authors, Genres, Categories & Series
Keep your collection organized and help readers discover books by the writers and subjects they enjoy.

✔ Gutenberg Book Gallery Block
Add customizable book grids using the built-in Book Catalogue Gallery block in the WordPress editor.

✔ Flexible Shortcode Support
Place your book catalogue in supported pages and posts without writing code.

✔ Easy Book Import
Add books manually, use basic CSV import when enabled in the plugin tools, or work with supported JSON import options.

✔ Multilingual & Translation-Ready
Use bundled language packs, local translation import/export, and a translation-ready interface to reach more readers.

✔ Privacy-Conscious by Design
No telemetry or usage tracking in the free plugin. Bundled translations work locally, and the plugin does not request Google Fonts.

Whether you’re an independent author showcasing a new release, a librarian organizing thousands of titles, or a collector sharing your favorite books, Librarysol gives you the freedom to build a professional catalogue your way.

🔄 Tired of Your Current WordPress Book Catalogue Plugin?

Looking for a better, easier, and completely free alternative to your existing WordPress book catalogue plugin?

Switching to Librarysol Book Catalogue Manager is easier than ever! If you’re currently using RS WP Book Showcase or WP Books Gallery, you can migrate your existing book collection in just a few clicks — without starting from scratch!

✔ One-Click Book Catalogue Migration
Easily transfer your existing books to Librarysol with our built-in migration tools.

✔ Migrate from Popular WordPress Book Plugins
Seamlessly migrate your book catalogue from RS WP Book Showcase and WP Books Gallery.

✔ Keep Your Existing Book Collection
Save time by transferring supported book information instead of manually recreating your catalogue.

✔ Unlimited Books, Unlimited Possibilities
Manage as many books, authors, categories, genres, and series as you need — without artificial limits.

✔ Beautiful & Responsive Book Galleries
Give your existing book collection a fresh, professional appearance with modern grid and list layouts.

✔ 100% Free Migration
No migration fees, no premium licence, and no hidden charges. Switch to Librarysol completely free!

🚀 Why settle for limitations when you can have more for free?

Migrate from RS WP Book Showcase or WP Books Gallery to Librarysol Book Catalogue Manager today and experience a smarter, more flexible way to manage your WordPress book collection!

📚 Try Librarysol Book Catalogue Manager – Completely FREE!

✅ Included Free — No Catalogue Limits

  • Unlimited Books — no book-count restrictions
  • Unlimited Authors — organize your collection by writer
  • Unlimited Categories, Genres & Series — build a logical, browsable catalogue
  • Grid Book Gallery — present covers in an attractive visual layout
  • List Catalogue Layout — offer an alternative browsing experience
  • Dedicated Single Book Pages — give every title its own profile
  • Book Covers & Descriptions — showcase what makes every book special
  • Bibliographic Fields — ISBN, publisher, year, pages, language, edition, format, and more
  • Book Search — make titles easier to find
  • Basic Filters — help readers narrow the selection
  • Sorting & Pagination — keep browsing manageable as your collection grows
  • Responsive Frontend Layouts — present your catalogue across screen sizes
  • Gutenberg Book Gallery Block — insert book grids in the block editor
  • Shortcodes — place catalogues in supported WordPress content
  • Basic CSV Import — available when enabled in plugin tools
  • Bundled Language Packs — use local translation resources
  • Translation Import/Export — manage supported local translations
  • No Licence or Paid Add-On Required — all functionality bundled in the free plugin remains available

🔧 Optional Integrations & Extended Use Cases

  • WooCommerce-Related Features — available where supported; WooCommerce must be installed for functions that depend on it
  • Optional QR-Code Images — where enabled, generated using the disclosed external QR image service
  • Optional Affiliate-Link Health Checks — check configured retailer URLs when enabled
  • JSON URL Import — retrieve a JSON file explicitly selected by an authorized site administrator

Important: These items are not a separate Pro-feature list. They describe options or integrations associated with the plugin. Some require another plugin or contact an external service, as detailed in the WordPress.org listing.

✔ Bookstores & Book Businesses
Help visitors browse book information and use supported integrations as your website grows.

Create a book directory that complements your reviews, recommendations, and literary content.

sections.installation:
Install Librarysol as a regular WordPress plugin. Here are different ways to install plugin:

Install by search plugin:

  1. In your Admin, go to menu Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Librarysol
  3. Click to install
  4. Activate the plugin

Install by upload plugin:

  1. Download the latest version of Librarysol
  2. In your Admin, go to menu Plugins > Add New
  3. Select “Upload Plugin”
  4. Click on “Choose File”
  5. Select downloaded plugin .zip and click on “Install Now” button
  6. Activate the plugin
